Operations.Name: KeychaincredentialCreate
Operations.Description:
Create a Keychain Credential.

The following `type`s are supported:
 * `SSH_KEY_PAIR`
 * `SSH_CREDENTIALS`

Arguments.Name: keychain_credential_create
Arguments.Description: Credential configuration data for the new keychain entry.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: Unique identifier of the keychain credential to delete.

Operations.Description: Discover a remote host key (useful for `SSH_CREDENTIALS`)

Operations.Name: KeychaincredentialRemoteSshSemiautomaticSetup
Operations.Description:
Perform semi-automatic SSH connection setup with other TrueNAS machine.

It creates an `SSH_CREDENTIALS` credential with specified `name` that can be used to connect to TrueNAS machine
with specified `url` and temporary auth `token`. Other TrueNAS machine adds `private_key` to allowed
`username`'s private keys. Other `SSH_CREDENTIALS` attributes such as `connect_timeout` can be specified as
well.

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Configuration data for semi-automatic SSH credential setup.

Operations.Name: KeychaincredentialSetupSshConnection
Operations.Description:
Creates an SSH Connection performing the following steps:

1) Generate SSH Key Pair if required
2) Set up SSH Credentials based on `setup_type`

In case (2) fails, it will be ensured that SSH Key Pair generated (if applicable) in the process is
removed.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: SSH connection setup configuration (manual or semi-automatic).

Operations.Name: KeychaincredentialUpdate
Operations.Description:
Update a Keychain Credential with specific `id`.

Please note that you can't change `type`. You must specify full `attributes` value.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: Unique identifier of the keychain credential to update.
